column1: === KEY METRICS DASHBOARD: AI Agent Payments Dashboard ===
=== The 6 Numbers Every SaaS Founder Should Know ===
Target CAC payback: <12 months → ACHIEVED in ~0.05 months
All scenarios far exceed 3:1 target — unit economics are exceptional
Note: Developer SDK products tend to have lower churn (integration lock-in)
[ASSUMPTION] CAC: $2 blended (via organic HN launch + Discord)
The model is MOST sensitive to:
3. HN launch success (determines which scenario materializes)
=== WHAT THIS MEANS FOR THE FOUNDER ===
- Pre-revenue/early runway needed: $154K-$6.9M depending on scenario
- Break-even target: **Month 8-10** achievable in bull/base case
- HN launch is critical — zero CAC acquisition in first 30 days
- LTV:CAC of 521:1 (base) means $1 in acquisition returns $521 in gross profit
- Freemium-to-paid conversion is key metric (target: 5%+ conversion)
- Solo founder for 9 months preserves runway
- Usage fees at scale add 8-15% beyond subscription MRR
